intro: A bowl of mee calong has an estimated 420 kcal. Most of the calories come from the yellow noodles. Next is the calong (fish balls and fish cakes) in the soup.
diet: Yes, mee calong is one of the more diet-friendly noodle choices. It's a soup dish, not too oily, and the fish calong gives you decent protein. Go for the soup version and ask for less fried shallots. Good for breakfast or lunch.
tips: Choose the soup version, not the fried one.
Ask for more calong and less mee for extra protein.
Add sawi or kangkung if the stall has it.

swap.name: Calong soup without mee + half portion of rice
swap.why: You still get the fish protein, the carbs are more controlled and you still feel full.

faq.a: Calong is a fish ball or fish cake popular in Terengganu and Kelantan. It's usually eaten with clear soup or peanut sauce.

faq.q: Where does mee calong come from?
faq.a: Mee calong is linked to the East Coast, especially Kuala Terengganu.

faq.q: What fish is calong made from?
faq.a: Usually fish like ikan parang or tamban, mixed with flour and shaped into balls or flat cakes.
